blocks.text: Pitt Meadows condos and townhomes by price band, September 2026

14 condos and townhomes sold in September against 66 listed. The price band with the most sales was $600,001 to $700,000, with 4 sold (29% of the month). Among bands with at least ten homes listed, the highest sales ratio was $700,001 to $800,000 at 36%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Bands with nothing listed and nothing sold are left out. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Pitt Meadows condos and townhomes by bedroom count, September 2026
Splitting September 2026 by size, the most sales came from the 3 bedrooms group, with 7 of 14 sold, against 15 of 66 listed.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
